title: architecture/index.yaml
description: Repo-wide architecture settings: one section per language, keyed by its id in languages.yaml; node mapping lives in the LikeC4 model metadata. Keys starting with x- are the repo's own and ignored. Values whose problems the arch-check reports as findings (legacy_arrows, diagrams, view_depth) are deliberately unconstrained here.

diagrams.description: arc42 doc -> view ids; checked by diagrams-fresh.

view_depth.description: view id -> render depth; checked by diagrams-fresh.

root_package.description: The language root's unit, under source_root.

source_root.description: Repo-relative directory containing root_package; default: the repo root.

tsconfig.description: Repo-relative tsconfig for module resolution; default: the nearest tsconfig.json.
